name: Zendesk API token
description: A password-like token generated in Admin Center and sent with the account email address as Basic authentication credentials ({email_address}/token:{api_token}); documented as deprecated and being retired.

blockers.summary: Zendesk states no prefix, alphabet or length for an API token; only a 40-character documentation example is given.
Phase 2 (2026-10-27) and final deactivation (2027-04-30) lie after the observation date; their application cannot yet be observed.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
